label: 前臂跪姿 / 臀部高位
pose_lead: Grounded pose, kneeling on the forearms with the hips high:
lower_limbs: Both knees and lower legs support on the ground, the knees bent, the seat clearly lifted.
upper_limbs: Both forearms, not the palms, rest on the ground, the arms bent.
torso_head: The chest hangs below the hips, the back sloping downward; the head low and turned to one side.
weight_silhouette: The forearms and knees carry the weight; front-low and rear-high, the body pressed even lower than a hands-forward kneel.
